menu_options.account: Sign in with Vine (automatic key retrieval)

account.title: Sign in to Vine
account.description: Your login is sent directly over HTTPS to the Tuya servers used by the Vine Thermostat app, only to authenticate your Vine account and retrieve device connection details. It is never sent to the integration developer. Your password and cloud session are not saved. Only your selected thermostat’s LAN key and product profile are stored in Home Assistant. Normal operation uses your local network.

device.title: Choose your thermostat
device.description: Select a thermostat from your Vine account. Compatible product schemas are configured automatically. Only the ST300 has been tested on physical hardware.

connect.title: Connect over the local network
connect.description: The local key was retrieved from your Vine account. Check the IP address and connect. If discovery is blocked by a VM or subnet boundary, enter the thermostat’s LAN address.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Protocol is detected automatically. Change it only when troubleshooting a connection.

error.invalid_key: Enter a local key containing exactly 16 UTF-8 bytes.
error.cannot_connect: No authenticated status received. Check IP address, local key and protocol version, and close the Vine app or other local clients.
error.invalid_auth: Vine rejected the account credentials. Check the email, password, region and country code.
error.cloud_error: Vine account setup failed ({code}). Check your region or use manual setup. CAPTCHA/MFA challenges are not supported.
error.no_devices: No Vine Wi-Fi thermostats with a local key were found in this account.
error.unsupported_schema: This product schema cannot be mapped safely. See supported devices in the documentation.
error.invalid_settings: Check the local key and product schema. Keys must contain exactly 16 UTF-8 bytes.

abort.invalid_selection: The selected device is no longer available.
abort.unsupported_model: This thermostat uses an unsupported or incomplete schema (product {product_id}). Please report the model and a product schema export so support can be added.
